rationale: Drifts the methodological qualifier on the CentNN citation from 'winner-loser dynamics' to 'winner-take-all dynamics'. CentNN updates both the winning and the losing centroid — this paper's own method section states 'The loser update is applied only when $N_p>1$' — whereas winner-take-all updates only the winner. The drift therefore mis-describes the cited algorithm AND contradicts the citing paper's own description. Cite key untouched; one existing phrase perturbed.
ground_truth_description: CentNN citation: update rule described as 'winner-take-all' instead of the cited method's 'winner-loser dynamics'.

truth.claim_sentence_verbatim: Among modern clustering approaches, centroid neural network (CentNN) \cite{park2000centroid} is a prototype-based algorithm that follows a competitive-learning paradigm, where centroid vectors are updated online through winner-loser dynamics.
